notes: Recorded by sim-parity with Helius-funded holders before the funding-moved rule existed. Failed simulations are dropped because that run did not record whether the funding wallet moved; the new rule keeps a failed sample only when it did not (a wallet that spends between bracket and simulation trips Raydium's user_source.amount < amount_in check, InsufficientFunds = 40, which is not pool state). Successful samples are unchanged and each was verified by vault conservation against the bracketed state.
